subject: Using lavaan to calculate a confidence interval for the variance of a Normal distribution

messages.author: b5544e752e856721
messages.subject: Using lavaan to calculate a confidence interval for the variance of a Normal distribution
parts:
Hello,

On stack exchange I find an article about using lavaan to calculate a confidence interval for the variance of a Normal distribution: http://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/83070/computing-confidence-intervals-for-population-variance-from-a-sample-in-r

I'm wondering is lavaan using the chi-squared distribution to calculate a 95% confidence interval for the variance?

That is, by calculating:
 (  (n-1)s^2 / C_u, (n-1)s^2 / C_l )
where n = sample size, s^2 = sample variance, C_u = 0.025 quantile of chi-squared distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom, C_l = 0.975 quantile of chi-squared distribution with n-1 degrees of freedom

When I try to do it this way I get a different answer from lavaan and am wondering why?

Kind Regards,
Avril
